description: AGSC-01-20: an item carrying release: <key> is published only when releases[<key>] is true. Derivation over the minimal fixture with releases {"autumn": false, "spring": true} in the configuration and two items in the cluster agent-patterns: cedar (release: autumn) and dogwood (release: spring). Held back, cedar is on no surface at all: no emitted file has a route or bytes that contain the string cedar (in_no_file), so it has no page, no per-item copy, no graph entry, no search, llms or chunk entry, no skill-pack member and no place on an index page or in the sitemap. Released, dogwood is published like any item: its page and per-item copies are emitted and the listing surfaces name it. The build is run with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set and no git history.
